summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of OnePermit landing page - a unified IVF and surrogacy care platform. All sections render correctly with Framer Motion animations, tab switching works, mobile responsiveness is excellent, and all anchor links navigate properly.
critical_code_review_comments: All 11 landing page components are well-structured with proper data-testid attributes
Framer Motion animations work correctly with whileInView triggers
Glass-morphism CSS classes (glass, glass-strong) are properly implemented
Mobile responsiveness is handled well with Tailwind breakpoints
Tab switching in TabsSection works correctly with AnimatePresence
seed_data_creation: N/A - Pure frontend landing page with hardcoded content
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend tests passed. Tested: Hero section with gradient background and 4 floating 3D elements (heart, bottle, pill, star), navbar with glass-morphism on scroll, mobile menu toggle, marquee section with partner names, about section with floating lifestyle images (desktop only), tabs section with Track/Monitor/Support switching, community section with horizontally scrollable clinic cards, testimonials section with 3 gradient cards, benefits section with 6 feature cards, CTA section with glass-morphism card, footer with link columns and social links. All anchor links work correctly. Mobile responsiveness at 375px width is excellent with no horizontal overflow.

hero_section.details: Gradient background renders, massive headline visible, 4 floating 3D elements present, 2 CTA buttons clickable

navbar.details: Fixed at top, glass-morphism effect on scroll works, logo and nav links visible, mobile menu toggle works correctly

marquee_section.details: Scrolling partner names visible including 'Fertility First IVF' and 'SurroMatch'

about_section.details: Massive uppercase text visible, floating lifestyle images appear on desktop (XL breakpoint)

tabs_section.details: 3 tabs (Track/Monitor/Support) present, clicking tabs changes content and mockup visuals correctly

community_section.details: 6 clinic cards with pastel backgrounds, horizontal scroll works, 'See all partners' link present

testimonials_section.details: 3 gradient cards with quotes and avatar images render correctly

benefits_section.details: 3x2 grid of 6 feature cards with icons (Bell, Activity, Link2, Users2, Trophy, Shield) renders correctly

cta_section.details: Glass-morphism card with 'Get Started Free' button visible and clickable

footer_section.details: Logo, 4 link columns (Product, Company, Resources, Legal), social links (Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn), copyright © 2026 present

anchor_navigation.details: How it Works -> #about, Features -> #features, Community -> #community, Stories -> #testimonials all work

mobile_responsiveness.details: At 375px width: layout stacks properly, text readable, no horizontal overflow, mobile menu toggle works

data_testid_coverage.details: All interactive elements have data-testid attributes: homepage, landing-navbar, navbar-logo, nav-login, nav-get-started, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, hero-section, hero-cta-primary, hero-cta-secondary, marquee-section, about-section, about-cta, tabs-section, tab-buttons, tab-track, tab-monitor, tab-support, tab-cta-*, clinic-card-*, community-see-all, testimonials-section, testimonial-card-*, benefits-section, benefit-card-*, cta-section, cta-final-button, footer-section
